Bug_Explanation: The Spring @Controller 'HelloWorldController' has a non-singleton scope defined using '@Scope("prototype")', which is not recommended as it could cause unnecessary churn and additional load on the server.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testNonSingletonScope' creates an instance of the 'HelloWorldController' and calls the'showBug' method. This triggers the bug as the 'HelloWorldController' has a non-singleton scope defined using '@Scope("prototype")' which is not recommended.
